strategy.unionDomainRange: emit one relation per OWL object property and allow every named union member to play the appropriate subject/object role
strategy.inverseProperties: emit the inverse property as its own relation; preserve OWL inverse/functionality characteristics as report metadata
strategy.datetimeProperties: flatten xsd:date and xsd:dateTime variants to TypeDB datetime attributes
strategy.multipleInheritance: choose the deterministic first named superclass; preserve equivalent-class restrictions in the IR/report for later axiom-query generation
